description: Search Google Data Commons statistical variables by plain-language indicator, e.g. "median household income" -> Median_Income_Household, "unemployment rate" -> UnemploymentRate_Person. Returns variable ids with names and a match score. Use the id as `variable` in datacommons_observation.

_apiKey.description: Data Commons API key (free). Get one at https://apikeys.datacommons.org

query.description: What you want to measure, e.g. "life expectancy", "CO2 emissions per capita"

name: datacommons_find_variable
title: Datacommons Find Variable
